checkpoint.ablation: enable_presyn only; the shared causal distance barrier remains enabled

protocol.calibration: match ON mean greedy repetition with OFF; minimize absolute delta, ties smaller lambda
protocol.frequency_penalty: subtract lambda times token count in prefix plus emitted history
protocol.primary: greedy on-minus-off mean repeated generated trigram occurrences per 22 slots
protocol.stops: BOS or assistant_end stops before further content; no tools or abstention policy
protocol.uncertainty: paired document bootstrap with 10,000 resamples, seed 0; conditional on this checkpoint, shard, sampling seed and prompt selection

scope: Exploratory acute inference switch on one trained checkpoint. No retraining or D1 selection.
